items.html: Andrew Britton, a right-arm fast bowler, comes from a strong cricketing family and plays for Donemana CC. Britton was Ireland's leading wicket-taker in the 2008 Under-19 World Cup in Malaysia and earned his call-up to the national side next year for an Intercontinental Cup game against Kenya.

His harbours desires to own his own bricklaying business. Andrew Flintoff is his idol.
Cricinfo Staff June 2009
